title: System and operations documentation drift audit
summary: A code-anchored sweep of 363 system and operations pages, with 19 verified drift rows, ten replacement paragraphs, and five documentation follow-up slices; the page inventory distinguishes mechanical coverage from manual claim checks.

implementationTasks.title: Repair remaining active-page links and finish semantic pass
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Documentation only. Use docs/docs-drift-audit-2026-09-29/page-inventory.csv as the page checklist. Triage unresolved links in active docs under docs/system and docs/operations; repair moved code/schema targets, exclude intentional examples, and verify each remaining factual operator instruction against current owning source.
